fields.statement: At head a5f095ccc: CLAUDE.md is the single line @AGENTS.md and this Claude Code session loaded AGENTS.md's full guidance through that import; diff of the old CLAUDE.md body against AGENTS.md shows the six sections moved verbatim. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run TestClaudeMDImportsAgentsMD passes. make self-check from a clean detached checkout of the head: ok.

At head a5f095ccc: agents/README.md exists, links back to ../AGENTS.md and holds the index (no role docs yet); AGENTS.md links [agents/README.md](agents/README.md). TestAgentDocsConsistent passes on the repo; adding an unindexed agents/qa.md by hand makes it fail with 'agents/README.md does not index qa.md', and removing the file makes it pass again.

At head a5f095ccc ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run TestAgentDocsConsistent -v: the repo case and the fixture table (ok, unindexed doc, no AGENTS link, broken link) pass. Mutated the real docs by hand: an unindexed agents/qa.md, AGENTS.md's index link changed to agents/READ.md, and [x](missing.md) appended to agents/README.md each made TestAgentDocsConsistent fail with the matching problem; a missing link inside a code span did not; restoring the files made it pass.

At head a5f095ccc go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run TestClaudeMDScopedTests passes, now reading AGENTS.md; AGENTS.md has the scoped commands and the never make check/make test/bare go test ./... rule, with no unqualified make check line.

At head a5f095ccc TestClaudeMDScopedTests (reading AGENTS.md) and go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/guide -run 'TestBuildText|TestReviewText' pass; AGENTS.md keeps the unstable-CI reproduce-locally rule unchanged.

At head a5f095ccc TestClaudeMDScopedTests (reading AGENTS.md) and go test -trimpath ./internal/guide -run 'TestBuildText|TestReviewText' pass; AGENTS.md has the inject-a-delay, never-busy-loops rule beside the unstable-CI rule.

At head a5f095ccc AGENTS.md's Bug requests section names rhiza request --kind bug, .rhiza/dispatch.toml, plan-bug and bugfix. With a binary built from the head: rhiza request --help shows --kind; rhiza workflow describe plan-bug and bugfix succeed in this checkout and show autonomy plan auto and accept auto; .rhiza/dispatch.toml and both workflow files exist.
At head a5f095ccc make help lists update, and go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run TestClaudeMDCommandsNameMakeUpdate passes, now reading AGENTS.md's Commands block.
